extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p5-outbox-numbering -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml with the p5-outbox-numbering batch> -Clean (staging %TEMP%/codelab-extract/p5-outbox-numbering, outside the repo; scrub findings are expected before the rewrite; secret scan clean)
promotion: Each staged file was read as a reference and rewritten with starter names and structure; "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. A "staged" entry stays in staging with its reason.

origins.note: Rewritten behind the IOutboxStore port on the messaging schema: an explicit Status column (Pending/Processing/Sent/Failed as int) instead of a processed timestamp, the READPAST/UPDLOCK/ROWLOCK claim kept as one CTE UPDATE ... OUTPUT ordered by id, attempts counted on claim, outcome updates guarded by status and attempt, a final-attempt abandoned lease marked Failed instead of left pending, and only a classified error code stored (never the exception message). The 1/5/15/60-minute back-off and 5-minute lease moved to OutboxDrainSchedule; the attempt limit is OutboxLimits.MaxAttempts.

origins.deferred: Enlisting the outbox row in the caller's unit of work (add, never save) needs a shared transaction across module contexts; the starter EfOutbox (phase 2) keeps saving on its own context and documents the ordering rule.

origins.note: Rewritten as IOutboxDrainRunner.DrainOnceAsync (no scheduler attribute; the jobs module schedules it) plus OutboxDispatcher: routing by type to the single registered IOutboxHandler in a DI scope per delivery, per-message failure isolation, a no-handler type failed at once, the Messaging:Outbox:Enabled switch (on by default) and bounded batches per pass. Left behind: the follow-up scheduling kinds, the notification replay and dedup frame (handlers are idempotent per MessageId instead), the log-context correlation push and the fingerprint sites.

Rewritten from a MERGE WITH (HOLDLOCK) counter table to one SQL SEQUENCE per prefix and year in schema numbering, created on demand (2714 race swallowed in SQL, NO CACHE). Formatting and the 2-6 uppercase-letter prefix rule moved to Application RequestNumberFormat; the year comes from TimeProvider in Numbering:TimeZoneId (RequestNumberAllocator) instead of a caller-supplied Gregorian year.
